reason_for_revision: v1 correctly identified connector capabilities but was too permissive about testing repository workflow metadata. The active cross_field write boundary authorizes only role-local state/output paths plus own immutable receipts, so branch/issue/PR mutations cannot be used as this role's validation surface even when the connector exposes those actions.

classes.class: durable cross-run state, replay, audit, idempotency and conflict-safe coordination
classes.kernel: immutable events and root manifests + one CAS HEAD + stable op_id + reconstruction-first retry

classes.class: multi-object atomic publication and interruption recovery
classes.evidence: r133 created A/B events and a new root without moving HEAD; fresh reconstruction remained at old A/B state; same-op retry reused candidate root and advanced once; stale CAS returned 409

classes.class: long-horizon bounded work across recurring scheduled-Chat invocations
classes.candidate: persist an exact operation token/frontier in role-local state, end one invocation before applying it, then in a later invocation reconstruct from authoritative role-local state and continue without conversation/process memory
classes.acceptance_condition: later invocation must discover the pending op from role-local durable state, not from conversational history, and complete or safely no-op it under the retry state machine

classes.evidence: GitHub Contents create/update/readback plus current-blob CAS; deterministic retry absorbed stale and repository-head 409 conflicts

classes.class: branches, refs, issues and PR metadata
classes.capability_observation: scheduled-Chat GitHub connector exposes such mutation actions
classes.why_not_tested: those mutations are outside the active cross_field role-local file/receipt write boundary; capability schema is not acceptance evidence
zero_quota_substitute_candidates: represent the needed coordination/result in authorized role-local content files when that is materially equivalent
have an appropriately authorized CLEAN role independently test its own permitted surface; cross_field does not consume that other-role result
classes.scope_caveat: the second candidate does not solve this role's child and cannot be counted here unless the material outcome is independently reproducible inside cross_field's boundary

classes.mechanism: scheduled-Chat public web retrieval plus role-local checkpointing

classes.class: arbitrary private-repository shell/build/test execution with full dependency environment

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: retrieve only the source slice and authoritative specification needed for a property, then verify the property directly in scheduled Chat without claiming full-build equivalence
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.limit: only counts where the requested material outcome is exactly the verified property

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.idea: replace the execution leaf with a small independently checkable certificate over connector-readable source
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.limit: full environment-sensitive build/test remains unresolved if the certificate is not outcome-equivalent

classes.class: authenticated UI interaction or external service effect with no authorized scheduled-Chat write action

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.condition: must be directly available to the executing role, materially effect-equivalent, tested, zero-manual-rescue and zero optional quota dependency

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.candidate: outcome redesign onto an already-authorized role-local effect surface
zero_quota_substitute_candidates.condition: must preserve the material outcome; recording an intent for a human or richer executor is not parity

classes.class: durable binary artifact/storage beyond ordinary text contents

zero_quota_substitute_candidates.condition: binary can be regenerated deterministically when the material requirement is semantic content rather than durable binary bytes
must remain within ordinary repository-content transport limits and avoid LFS/artifact/package quotas

zero_quota_substitute_candidates: unprivileged outcome redesign entirely inside authorized effects
verifiable proposal/certificate only when the protected execution is not itself part of the material outcome
classes.hard_rule: a protected/manual handoff never counts as Phase-1 parity

eliminates: continuously-running coordinator dependency for role-local state
